notes:
{魅力的|みりょくてき} is a na-adjective meaning attractive or charming, derived from ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧ (charm, appeal).

FORMS:
- {魅力的|みりょくてき}な + noun: attractive ~
- {魅力的|みりょくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: attractively

CAN DESCRIBE:
- People: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (attractive person)
- Offers: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (attractive terms)
- Places: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ (charming town)
- Ideas: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧ (appealing proposal)

COMPARISON:
- {魅力的|みりょくてき}: attractive/charming (formal, versatile)
- ⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧: cute (casual, appearance-focused)
- ⟦かっこいい→かっこいい：09378_kakkoii⟧: cool/handsome (casual, appearance-focused)
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: beautiful (formal, aesthetic)
